small_n.note: fewer than 10 hosts in the within-host metric: too small to interpret
fewer than 10 hosts in the within-host metric: too small to interpret

d10_split.rule: within published d10: group12 = all d-block cations in Zn, Cd, Hg; group11 = all in Cu, Ag, Au (all d10, so Cu+, Ag+, Au+); group11_and_12 = both present; U_treated = any Zn or Cu cation (PBEsol+U with U_eff = 5 eV on Cu and Zn d only, docs/provenance.md row 4), U_untreated = the other d10 hosts

estimator.big_draws: HierDraws.make([164] * 30, 20000, seed) reproduced in chunks of 1000 with the same generator consumption; its first 2000 replicates equal the paper draws
estimator.pooled: replicate = sum over the 30 slots of the draw-weighted class numerator / sum of the draw-weighted class denominator; point = same with unit weights; within-host MAE = wsum / wn (hosts with >= 2 tested sites); site MAE = sabs / n
estimator.small_n: groups with fewer than 10 hosts in the within-host metric are flagged too small to interpret (reported, not suppressed)

filled_d_bins.classes: data/host_dbins_v1.csv column 'bin' (docs/deviations.md 2026-10-10): d10 = at least one cation with a filled d shell (group-11/12 and filled-(n-1)d p-block cations: Zn2+, Cd2+, Ga3+, In3+, Sn4+, Pb2+, Bi3+, Ag+ ...) and none partially filled; d0 = no cation with d electrons (s-block, early p-block, f-block and d0 transition-metal cations); other = any cation with 1-9 d electrons; unassigned = no oxidation state
filled_d_bins.comparator: bins_d0_plus_other = d0 + other of that file (all classified non-d10 hosts; the 9 unassigned excluded)

host_cluster.scheme: bootstrap over the distinct hosts tested in any of the 30 resamples; multinomial weights (n = 818), 20000 replicates, numpy default_rng(20261008) in chunks of 1000; a drawn host carries the sum of its host statistics over all its test appearances; class value = pooled ratio of weighted sums (unstratified: class sizes vary between replicates)

payload.label: TRV1 T3/M22/M24: robustness of the within-host descriptor gain S - D* by cation d-shell configuration, 654 hosts, 30 x 5, pooled class estimator of analysis/dshell/dshell_gain.py

mc_stability.contrast: gain_d10 - gain_rest, S - D*, rest = d0 + partial_d + main_group (published classes)

post_transition_split.rule: main-group hosts with post_transition_d10_core (published flag); per post-transition cation (p block, Z >= 31, groups 13-18) from cation_states of results/derived_dshell/dshell_classes.json: s0 if state = group - 10 (Ga3+, Ge4+, As5+, In3+, Sn4+, Sb5+, Te6+, Tl3+, Pb4+, Bi5+), s2 if state = group - 12 (Ge2+, As3+, In+, Sn2+, Sb3+, Te4+, Tl+, Pb2+, Bi3+); host = s0 / s2 if all its post-transition cations are that kind, mixed if both occur. light = main group without a post-transition cation

relative.definitions: zero-skill = within-host residual MAE of a predictor constant within each host = sum |y - host mean y| / wn over hosts with >= 2 tested sites (model independent); gain = MAE_S - MAE_D*; gain_over_S = gain / MAE_S; gain_over_zero_skill = gain / zero-skill; ratios per replicate on the paper draws (2000, seed 20261008), point = ratio of point values

reproduction.source: results/derived_dshell/dshell_gain.json payload.primary (point, ci95, boot_sd) and payload.groups.*.(gains.S_minus_Dstar, models.S, models.Dstar).{within_host_mae, mae} (point, ci95), counts

payload.sign_convention: gain = MAE_S - MAE_D* (positive = D* more accurate); contrast = gain(a) - gain(b) per replicate on shared draws; relative gains = gain / MAE_S or gain / zero-skill
